reviews.limitations: Source-reviewed bounded Rust calendar and Date migration, plus Gregorian/Latin-digit DateTimeFormatter. The browser supplies timezone resolution, locale names/templates and the existing parser. Custom patterns are validated atomically. Historical Flash coercion, timezone/parser/locale behavior and native subclasses remain incomplete. getTimezoneOffset/timezoneOffset remain host facilities and are excluded from migration rows. Formatter locale enumeration covers a bounded candidate list. The ordinary HTML5 family passed 36/36 AS3 checks and the AS2 group; Run again advanced 1 to 2 and Restart returned to 1. This is representative family acceptance, not individual API conformance or original-player proof.

reviews.title: Runtime hour 2: Convolution, bevel and gradient filters
reviews.reason: Source review and accepted ordinary HTML5 export in this bounded runtime hour. Evidence fingerprints capture the accepted working tree based on recordedHead; that commit alone does not identify the modified source bytes. Delivery report: docs/AS-RUNTIME-HOUR-2.md.
reviews.limitations: Source-reviewed shared Rust convolution, bevel, gradient glow and gradient bevel kernels with bounded copied values and clone methods in AS2/AS3. Convolution accepts dimensions 0..15 and exactly matrixX*matrixY coefficients; gradients accept 0..16 ordered stops with equal arrays. Existing raster/work budgets and transparent BitmapData destination limits apply. Native UI, displacement/shader filters, exact Flash kernels/coercion and cacheAsBitmap conformance remain outside this batch. An initial example matrix-setup failure was fixed. Final ordinary HTML5 acceptance passed 20/20 AS3 checks and the AS2 group with visible alternate, clear and Restart interactions. This is representative family acceptance, not exhaustive property or cross-browser Flash parity.

reviews.limitations: Source-reviewed Rust numeric formatting/parsing with bounded settings, grouping, negative formats, precision, UTF-16 parse offsets and 33 digit profiles. The browser supplies locale metadata; digit profiles expand one property rather than adding API names. Scientific notation parsing, full historical whitespace/coercion/error behavior, currency formatting, native subclasses and static locale enumeration remain unsupported. Ordinary HTML5 acceptance passed 19/19 checks with English, French and Arabic output, Run again and Restart. This is representative family acceptance, not individual API conformance or original Flash proof.
